pages.text: “A sea of vibrant blooms, dazzling and bright—warmth unfolds within the tea’s fragrance.”$(br2)Tulip Tea is a radiant and soothing beverage made from dried tulip petals. With its beautiful color and naturally sweet taste, drinking it temporarily increases the traveler’s maximum health, making them more resilient.
$(br2)$(br)To prepare Tulip Tea, $(br)blend any color of dried tulip petals with sugar.$(br)It is best consumed before an adventure, providing additional health capacity for extra protection.

Upon drinking Tulip Tea, travelers gain a temporary increase in maximum health, making them more durable in battle and better prepared for challenging encounters.$(br)This invigorating tea grants a sense of security and endurance.$(br)If JEI is installed, press R while hovering over the icon to view the recipe.
